subject: Proposal: 8-GPU reserved pool + throughput SLA — pricing concession request
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Amir Shah <amir@heliohealth.com>, Priya Desai <priya.desai@heliohealth.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T15:20:00Z
Subject: Proposal: 8-GPU reserved pool + throughput SLA

Hi Amir / Priya,

Thanks for the time today — appreciated the deep dive into Helio's inference needs for your clinical pipeline. Based on our conversation I put together a targeted Dedicated package that matches your throughput and latency constraints and gives predictable unit cost for production. Summary below; attached is a short mutual action plan and a side-by-side pricing comparison for context.

Proposal (initial):
- Reserved GPU pool: 8 x A100-equivalent GPUs (multi-tenant within your dedicated pool).
- Throughput target: baseline support for ~60 concurrent low-latency streams (2k token avg), with autoscale burst to 90 for short periods.
- Latency SLO: p95 < 175ms for typical 2k-token responses (non-streaming).
- Commit term: 12 months reserved capacity (monthly billing).
- List price: $32,000 / month (baseline reserved rate).

Helio asked about pricing flexibility and credits given the strategic nature of this engagement. We're open to a concession for a referenceable pilot and accelerated case study. My ask: can we consider a one-time credit and an introductory discount off the list reserved rate?

Next steps: if this structure looks directionally right, I can share an updated proposal with the concession language and a short pilot success criteria doc.

Attachments: Helio_MutualActionPlan_20261101.pdf, pricing_comp_matrix_20261101.xlsx

Thanks,
Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
vivek@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0134
From: Amir Shah <amir@heliohealth.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-02T09:47:00Z
Subject: Re: Proposal: 8-GPU reserved pool + throughput SLA

Vivek —

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the clear numbers. Two things from our side: 1) we have a competing offer from a cloud provider that is substantially cheaper on reserved capacity (they've quoted ~$20k/month for a similar baseline), and 2) our procurement requires either a significant discount or a usage credit to offset migration risk.

We're willing to move quickly if Redwood can come within ~25% of the competitor on committed pricing and include a $50k onboarding/usage credit to be applied over the first 3 months. We also need a firm SLA for p95 latency and a clause that guarantees throughput for the pilot period.

Can you escalate for a pricing exception? We're trying to finalize vendor by Nov 10.

— Amir
Amir Shah
Director of ML Engineering, Helio Therapeutics
amir@heliohealth.com
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-02T12:15:00Z
Subject: Fwd: Proposal: 8-GPU reserved pool + throughput SLA — escalation for discount exception

Naomi / Ben — forwarding Helio's reply. They have a competitive bid at ~$20k/mo and are asking for ~25% reduction from our list price plus a $50k onboarding credit. Helio looks very strategic (biotech reference, potential enterprise expansion across R&D). Key points for the ask:

- Concession request: reduce reserved monthly rate from $32k -> $24k (25% off) for first 6 months, then revert to 85% of list for remainder; AND provide a $50k one-time usage credit to be applied in the first 90 days.
- Gov requirement: include throughput guarantee for pilot (60 concurrent), with an ops playbook and rollback clause if SLA not met.
- Contract terms: 12-month reserved commit (preferred). If we shorten to 6-month pilot commit, we should price accordingly and add clawback if they scale down.

Rationale for approval:
- Helio is referenceable in the therapeutics vertical — high value for our GTM.
- Potential to convert to larger Dedicated pools across multiple teams.
- Competitor deal is aggressive; keeping them in the funnel preserves pipeline and opens case study.

Can finance / commercial approve a concession band here? If yes, I propose we offer a limited concession: 30% discount off list for first 3 months (not 6), $40k credit (not $50k), plus a strict SLA and a 12-month minimum commit. That gets us closer without full price erosion. Laura — would you sign off on exec exception if Finance agrees?

Attachments: pricing_comp_matrix_20261101.xlsx

Thanks,
Vivek
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-03T08:22:00Z
Subject: Re: Fwd: Proposal: 8-GPU reserved pool + throughput SLA — concession suggestion

Vivek — good summary. From finance/commercial POV I recommend the following compromise that balances revenue protection and competitive win probability:

- Discount: 30% off list for the first 3 months, then 15% off list for months 4–12.
- One-time credit: $40k onboarding credit applied across first 90 days.
- SLA: p95 latency clause for agreed request profile; if not met in two consecutive weeks during pilot we provide a 20% credit for that month (capped).
- Minimum commit: 9 months (we can structure as 12-month contract with a performance-based early-exit after month 9).
- Marketing/reference clause: Helio agrees to a joint case study and logo placement after completion of pilot.

If you add the clawback language (credit recapture if they shrink pool before 9 months) I'm comfortable recommending this to Laura for executive approval. Ben — pls confirm the accounting treatment and margin impact.

Naomi
Naomi Feldman
VP, Strategic Sales Operations
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Amir Shah <amir@heliohealth.com>, Priya Desai <priya.desai@heliohealth.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-04T11:07:00Z
Subject: RE: Proposal: 8-GPU reserved pool + throughput SLA — updated concession (subject to final exec sign-off)

Amir — thanks again. We can provisionally offer the following concession pending final exec sign-off (internal approvals in flight, expects sign-off within 48 hrs):

- Pricing: 30% off list for months 1–3, 15% off list for months 4–12 (12-month contract).
- One-time usage/onboarding credit: $40,000 applied across first 90 days.
- SLA & ops: p95 latency guarantee for agreed request profile; will ship an ops playbook and run a 2-week ramp verification window before full cutover. Credit recapture/clawback language if pool size is reduced below agreed baseline before month 9.

I've attached an updated proposal PDF that reflects the concession language and a mutual action plan that lays out milestones for the pilot (integration dates, pilot KPIs, success criteria). If this looks acceptable I'll share the DocuSign envelope for signature once I have Laura's final OK.

Attachments: redwood_proposal_8gpu_20261103.pdf, Helio_MutualActionPlan_20261101.pdf

Best,
Vivek
